sabarmati_ashram.name: Sabarmati Ashram (Gandhi Ashram)
sabarmati_ashram.description: Historic headquarters of Mahatma Gandhi from 1917 to 1930 and the starting point of the 1930 Salt March (Dandi Satyagraha), preserving Hriday Kunj, Gandhi's spinning wheel, and archives.

atal_pedestrian_bridge.name: Atal Pedestrian Bridge
atal_pedestrian_bridge.description: Award-winning 300-meter iconic foot overbridge on Sabarmati Riverfront inspired by kite festival colors, connecting the eastern and western promenades with stunning nighttime LED illumination.

sabarmati_riverfront.name: Sabarmati Riverfront Promenade
sabarmati_riverfront.description: 11.5 km beautifully landscaped waterfront promenade featuring tree-lined walkways, cycling tracks, speed boating, the annual International Flower Show, and sunset views.

adalaj_stepwell.name: Adalaj Stepwell (Rudabai Vav)
adalaj_stepwell.description: Subterranean architectural marvel built in 1498 by Queen Rudabai, descending five stories deep with intricately carved sandstone pillars, balconies, and cooler subterranean temperatures.

akshardham_temple_gandhinagar.name: Swaminarayan Akshardham (Gandhinagar)
akshardham_temple_gandhinagar.description: Sprawling 23-acre spiritual complex carved from 6,000 tonnes of pink Rajasthani sandstone without steel, featuring thematic exhibitions, serene gardens, and the Sat-Chit-Anand water show.

sidi_saiyyed_mosque.name: Sidi Saiyyed Mosque (Tree of Life)
sidi_saiyyed_mosque.description: Built in 1573, globally renowned for its exquisite semi-circular marble lattice window (Jali) depicting the 'Tree of Life', which serves as the official emblem of IIM Ahmedabad.

hutheesing_jain_temple.name: Hutheesing Jain Temple
hutheesing_jain_temple.description: Constructed in 1848 by merchant Hutheesing Kesarisinh, built with pristine white Makrana marble dedicated to 15th Tirthankara Lord Dharmanatha, featuring 52 mini-shrines and a soaring Manastambha.

kankaria_lake.name: Kankaria Lake & Nagina Wadi
kankaria_lake.description: Historic 15th-century polygonal lake completed by Sultan Qutb-ud-Din, featuring a central summer pleasure pavilion (Nagina Wadi), toy train (Atal Express), tethered balloon rides, and an annual December carnival.

bhadra_fort.name: Bhadra Fort & Teen Darwaza
bhadra_fort.description: Royal citadel built in 1411 by Sultan Ahmad Shah upon founding Ahmedabad, featuring fortified red stone bastions, royal palaces, a clock tower, and the grand Teen Darwaza ceremonial gateway.

jama_masjid_ahmedabad.name: Jama Masjid (Ahmedabad)
jama_masjid_ahmedabad.description: Monumental yellow sandstone congregational mosque built in 1424 by Ahmad Shah I, renowned for its serene arcaded courtyard supported by 260 carved pillars and 15 domes blending Hindu, Jain, and Islamic motifs.

science_city_ahmedabad.name: Gujarat Science City
science_city_ahmedabad.description: Comprehensive 107-hectare science center housing India's largest public Aquatic Gallery with underwater shark tunnels, a state-of-the-art Robotic Gallery, IMAX 3D Theatre, and Nature Park.

calico_museum_of_textiles.name: Calico Museum of Textiles
calico_museum_of_textiles.description: One of the premier textile museums in the world, founded in 1949 by Gautam and Gira Sarabhai, housing five centuries of rare royal court textiles, Kashmiri shawls, and Pichwai tapestries in wooden haveli architecture.

auto_world_vintage_car_museum.name: Auto World Vintage Car Museum
auto_world_vintage_car_museum.description: One of the largest private collections of vintage cars in Asia, showcasing over 115 immaculate classic vehicles including custom Rolls-Royces, Bentleys, Cadillacs, and horse-drawn carriages of Indian Maharajas.

shaking_minarets_sidi_bashir.name: Jhulta Minar (Sidi Bashir Shaking Minarets)
shaking_minarets_sidi_bashir.description: Mysterious 15th-century architectural enigma in Sarangpur: when one minaret is shaken, the other vibrates in resonance after a few seconds without transmitting vibration across the connecting bridge.

sarkhej_roza.name: Sarkhej Roza (The Acropolis of Ahmedabad)
sarkhej_roza.description: Exquisite 15th-century Sufi architectural complex and royal palace pavilions surrounding a central tank, praised by architect Le Corbusier as the 'Acropolis of Ahmedabad' for its peerless proportion and symmetry.

manek_chowk.name: Manek Chowk Night Food Market
manek_chowk.description: Fabled walled city square that transforms after dark into a buzzing culinary night market renowned for cheese pineapple sandwiches, Gwalior dosa, chocolate sandwiches, and Kulfi.

dandi_kutir_gandhinagar.name: Dandi Kutir Museum (Gandhinagar)
dandi_kutir_gandhinagar.description: India's largest museum dedicated to Mahatma Gandhi, housed inside a 41-meter high salt-mound shaped structure at Mahatma Mandir with immersive 3D audio-visual and laser exhibits.

indroda_dinosaur_and_fossil_park.name: Indroda Dinosaur & Fossil Park
indroda_dinosaur_and_fossil_park.description: Regarded as India's 'Jurassic Park', it is the second largest dinosaur egg hatchery in the world, featuring life-size fiberglass dinosaur models, authentic fossilized dinosaur eggs, and a botanical zoo.

narendra_modi_stadium.name: Narendra Modi Stadium (Motera)
narendra_modi_stadium.description: The world's largest cricket stadium with a seating capacity of 132,000 spectators, featuring 360-degree LED ring lights, clubhouse facilities, and host of ICC World Cup finals.

iskcon_temple_ahmedabad.name: ISKCON Temple (Hare Krishna Mandir)
iskcon_temple_ahmedabad.description: Majestic Rajasthani marble and Gujarati architectural temple on SG Highway dedicated to Sri Sri Radha Govindaji, featuring serene chanting halls and Govinda's prasadam restaurant.

dada_harir_stepwell.name: Dada Harir Stepwell (Bai Harir Vav)
dada_harir_stepwell.description: Subterranean stepwell built in 1499 in Asarwa featuring five octagonal subterranean pavilion storeys adorned with floral sculptures and dual Sanskrit and Arabic stone inscriptions.

law_garden_night_market.name: Law Garden Night Market
law_garden_night_market.description: Lively evening street market adjoining Law Garden renowned for traditional Gujarati Chaniya Cholis, mirror-work Bandhani dupattas, oxidized silver jewelry, and Kathiyawadi street snacks.

vastrapur_lake.name: Vastrapur Lake & Open Air Theatre
vastrapur_lake.description: Serene urban lake named after medieval poet Narsinh Mehta, surrounded by an open-air amphitheatre hosting classical music concerts, jogging track, and children's park.

gujarat_university_heritage.name: Gujarat University Clock Tower & LD Indology
gujarat_university_heritage.description: Landmark red-brick educational campus founded in 1949 with its iconic clock tower, housing the L.D. Institute of Indology with 75,000 rare palm-leaf manuscripts and ancient sculptures.

rani_no_hajiro.name: Rani no Hajiro (Tomb of the Queens)
rani_no_hajiro.description: Historical 15th-century open courtyard mausoleum of Sultan Ahmad Shah's queens, leading into a bustling traditional market famous for women's jewelry, brocades, and Mashru fabrics.

kamla_nehru_zoological_garden.name: Kamla Nehru Zoological Garden (Kankaria Zoo)
kamla_nehru_zoological_garden.description: Renowned 117-acre zoological park established in 1951 on Kankaria Lake shores, home to endangered Asiatic lions, Royal Bengal tigers, white peacocks, and a nocturnal animal house.

shree_camp_hanuman_temple.name: Camp Hanuman Temple (Cantonment)
shree_camp_hanuman_temple.description: One of the most revered Hanuman shrines in Gujarat, situated in Ahmedabad Military Cantonment with roots over 150 years old, attracting thousands of devotees on Tuesdays and Saturdays.

sanskar_kendra_city_museum.name: Sanskar Kendra & Kite Museum
sanskar_kendra_city_museum.description: Modernist museum building designed in 1954 by Swiss-French master architect Le Corbusier, housing the Ahmedabad City Museum and India's famous Patang (Kite) Museum.

vechaar_utensils_museum.name: Vechaar Utensils Museum (Vishalla)
vechaar_utensils_museum.description: Unique heritage museum conceived by Surendra Patel at Vishalla, showcasing over 4,500 traditional Indian utensils from clay to brass, copper, and bronze spanning 1,000 years.
vechaar_utensils_museum.best_time_to_visit: Evenings (coupled with Vishalla traditional Gujarati dinner)

gift_city_fintech_hub.name: GIFT City (Gujarat International Finance Tec-City)
gift_city_fintech_hub.description: India's premier operational smart city and International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) on Sabarmati banks, featuring futuristic glass skyscrapers and modern urban infrastructure.

puneet_van_gandhinagar.name: Puneet Van (Gandhinagar)
puneet_van_gandhinagar.description: Unique botanical and astrological garden in Gandhinagar Sector 19 where thousands of trees and medicinal herbs are planted according to zodiac signs (Rashi) and planetary constellations (Nakshatra).

sarita_udyan_gandhinagar.name: Sarita Udyan & Deer Park (Gandhinagar)
sarita_udyan_gandhinagar.description: Picturesque riverside picnic garden on the banks of Sabarmati in Gandhinagar Sector 9, featuring rolling lawns, shady flowering trees, and an adjoining deer sanctuary.

mahatma_mandir_gandhinagar.name: Mahatma Mandir Convention Centre
mahatma_mandir_gandhinagar.description: Monumental 34-acre convention and exhibition complex in Gandhinagar inspired by the philosophy of Mahatma Gandhi, venue of the biennial Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit.

lalbhai_dalpatbhai_museum.name: Lalbhai Dalpatbhai Museum (LD Museum)
lalbhai_dalpatbhai_museum.description: Treasure trove of ancient Indian art and archaeology, showcasing rare medieval stone sculptures, Chola and Gujarat bronzes, ancient coins, and illustrated Jain manuscripts.

alpha_one_ahmedabad_one_mall.name: Ahmedabad One Mall (Alpha One)
alpha_one_ahmedabad_one_mall.description: Premier shopping and entertainment destination in Vastrapur sprawling 1.2 million sq ft with international fashion brands, multi-cuisine food court, and Cinepolis multiplex.

palladium_mall_ahmedabad.name: Palladium Mall Ahmedabad
palladium_mall_ahmedabad.description: Ultra-luxury retail destination on Thaltej-SG Highway housing premier global fashion houses, luxury lifestyle brands, fine-dining restaurants, and state-of-the-art cinemas.

bhadrakali_temple.name: Bhadrakali Temple (Bhadra Fort)
bhadrakali_temple.description: Historic 14th-century temple dedicated to Goddess Bhadrakali, the revered patron guardian deity of Ahmedabad, situated right within the Bhadra Fort citadel.

baps_shri_swaminarayan_mandir_kalupur.name: Shri Swaminarayan Mandir (Kalupur)
baps_shri_swaminarayan_mandir_kalupur.description: The very first temple of the Swaminarayan Sampradaya built in 1822 under Lord Swaminarayan's personal direction, renowned for its jaw-dropping Burma teak wood carvings and heritage haveli architecture.

rani_sipri_mosque.name: Rani Sipri Mosque (Masjid-e-Nagina)
rani_sipri_mosque.description: Built in 1514 by Rani Asni (Sipri), revered as the 'Jewel of the Mosque' (Masjid-e-Nagina) for its delicate 50-foot minarets and intricate sandstone filigree work.

usmanpura_garden_riverfront.name: Usmanpura Riverfront Park
usmanpura_garden_riverfront.description: Serene riverside park on the western Sabarmati embankment featuring contemporary stone sculptures, lush lawns, waterfront steps, and cool evening breeze.

riverfront_flower_park.name: Riverfront Flower Park
riverfront_flower_park.description: Spectacular 45,000 sq meter permanent floral garden on Sabarmati banks showcasing millions of vibrant seasonal flowers, topiaries, and host to the annual Ahmedabad Flower Show.

parimal_garden.name: Parimal Garden (Ambawadi)
parimal_garden.description: Picturesque heritage city garden in Ambawadi featuring tranquil lotus ponds with water lilies, stone gazebos, arched walking bridges, and open-air gym.

c_g_road_shopping.name: C.G. Road Shopping District
c_g_road_shopping.description: Ahmedabad's most celebrated upscale commercial avenue in Navrangpura, lined with premier branded clothing showrooms, traditional silver jewelry stores, and sweet shops.

sindhu_bhavan_road_sbr.name: Sindhu Bhavan Road (SBR Lifestyle Strip)
sindhu_bhavan_road_sbr.description: The trendy lifestyle and nightlife corridor of western Ahmedabad, packed with chic open-air cafes, gourmet artisanal restaurants, drive-ins, and entertainment centers.

gandhinagar_vidhan_sabha.name: Gujarat Vidhan Sabha & Central Vista (Gandhinagar)
gandhinagar_vidhan_sabha.description: The political heart of Gujarat at Vithalbhai Patel Bhavan, set within the grandiose green Central Vista parkland of planned capital city Gandhinagar.

gujarat_high_court_sola.name: Gujarat High Court (Sola)
gujarat_high_court_sola.description: Imposing modern architectural complex on SG Highway serving as the highest judicial forum for the State of Gujarat with expansive landscaped gardens.

teen_darwaza.name: Teen Darwaza (Triple Gateway)
teen_darwaza.description: Historic triple-arched royal gateway constructed in 1415 by Sultan Ahmad Shah to serve as the grand ceremonial entrance to the royal Maidan-e-Shahi.

ahmed_shah_mosque.name: Ahmed Shah's Mosque
ahmed_shah_mosque.description: Erected in 1414, it is the oldest surviving mosque in Ahmedabad, built as the private royal chapel of founder Sultan Ahmad Shah inside Bhadra Fort.

amduranjan_amusement_kankaria.name: Balvatika & Butterfly Park (Kankaria)
amduranjan_amusement_kankaria.description: Enchanting children's park on Kankaria Lake peninsula featuring a mirror house, toy museum, butterfly sanctuary, and planetarium.

sarabhai_foundation_museum.name: Shreyas Folk Museum (Sarabhai Foundation)
sarabhai_foundation_museum.description: Vibrant folk museum showcasing the colorful tribal costumes, Kathiawar beadwork, Kutch embroideries, wood carvings, and puppet arts of Gujarat.
